headline: Etsy marketplace GMS rose 7.5% as growth sped up; it raised the FY outlook, cut 12% of staff and approved a $2bn buyback.
guidance_note: FY 2026 GMS growth raised to mid-single digits (from low single digits); Q3 GMS guided to $2.53-2.58bn (+4-6%), adj. EBITDA margin 28-30%.
key_messages: Etsy marketplace GMS ~$2.6bn, +7.5% YoY (+7.2% FX-neutral), the third straight quarter of growth; marketplace revenue +9.3%.
Active buyers ~87m (TTM), roughly flat YoY (one source: -0.4%); GMS per active buyer $124, +2.8% YoY.
App GMS +12.5% YoY, about 47% of GMS.
Restructuring cuts ~220 jobs (12%), with ~$35m in charges expected in Q3; CEO says it is about speed, not cost-cutting. $2bn buyback authorized.
Coverage notes rising competition from Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop and Temu.

consumer.big_ticket: Discretionary marketplace GMS accelerated while buyer count stayed flat, so growth came from spend per buyer.

macro_read: Discretionary online spending firmed in Q2 2026, but it came from existing buyers spending more rather than new buyers, which points to steady rather than broadening demand.
notes: Etsy reports GAAP only; the EPS shown is GAAP diluted EPS from continuing operations ($0.98 vs $0.39). Total diluted EPS was a $0.36 loss, driven by a $161.0m (-$1.34/share) Depop disposal charge in discontinued operations.
Depop was classified as discontinued operations (sale pending at quarter end); revenue growth of 6.2% is continuing-ops basis. Some outlets described sales as flat on a different basis.
Consensus left null: EPS estimates cited were $0.73 and $0.75, and AP/Zacks used a different 'adjusted' $1.34 vs $1.17.
Stock reaction left null: sources conflict (shares -0.66% on report day before after-hours results; later moves cited of flat, -0.4% and +4%).
Restructuring charges fall mainly in Q3, not Q2.
